description: Arpeggiator over as many as six input pitches, repeating and transposing the arpeggio to make a longer sequence

params.text: Holds the pitches, the arpeggio and the pattern at the values of the running cycle, randomised notes included, until it is pressed again; when it is off the pitches are read afresh each cycle
Starts the sequence from its beginning, once for each press
Chooses how the arpeggio is transposed from one repetition to the next: Up, Down, UpDown, DownUp, Rez or On The Run
Chooses the order the input pitches are played in: Right, Left, RightLeft or LeftRight
Sets how many times the arpeggio repeats in one sequence, 1 to 16
Sets how far each repetition is transposed from the one before, -24 to 24 steps, and at 0 the arpeggio repeats at the same pitch
Chooses what one transposition step means: a semitone, a step of the major scale or a step of the minor scale

inputs.text: A rising edge moves the sequence on by one note
A rising edge starts the sequence from its beginning; with nothing patched here the sequence runs on the clock without being started
One of the pitches the arpeggio is played over, as a 1V/octave voltage; jacks with nothing patched are skipped, and with all six empty a single 0V pitch is used
A voltage here chooses the transposition pattern, in place of the PATTERN knob; whole volts from 0V to 5V
A voltage here chooses the order the pitches are played in, in place of the ARP knob; whole volts from 0V to 3V
A voltage here sets how many repetitions the sequence runs, in place of the LENGTH knob; whole volts from 1V to 16V
A voltage here sets the transposition per repetition, in place of the STEPS knob; whole volts from -24V to 24V

outputs.text: The 1V/octave pitch of the note being played
Carries 10V on each note of the sequence, as a 1ms trigger, a retrigger or a continuous gate according to the menu
A 1ms trigger at the last note of each repetition of the arpeggio
A 1ms trigger at the last note of the whole sequence

notes: this module is kept for old patches and Arp 3.1 and Arp 3.2 take its place between them
the module has no clock of its own, so nothing plays until a clock is patched into CLOCK.
menu: Gate Mode — what the GATE output carries: Trigger, a 1ms trigger on each note; Retrigger, a gate dropping low for 1ms between notes; Continuous, a gate held high while the sequence runs

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
